title: Plankton lens
about: A script a page includes: every marked plot gets a badge when a connected registry knows its bytes (sha256), verified in the browser; a click opens the lineage in the graph viewer. It decorates someone else's page, so it is neither a leaf nor a block today.
use: <script src="lens.js" data-planktons="<union.json>[,…]" data-viewer="<graph viewer>" data-mirror="<static mirror>"></script>, plots marked img.lens or img[data-kton]
reads: registries by URL (union.json with keys.json/names.json) or a static content-addressed mirror; the plots' own bytes

block.planned: a block that shows one product with its badge: requires product@1 (the bytes, by hash) and graph@1 (the records that made them, verified here); optional open@1 (the lineage in the graph viewer). VERTICLE-HOSTS.md §8 lists it with query@1 too; that is for the reproduction count and comes with the block.
